Job Title: Business Intelligence Officer
Company: LOLC (CAMBODIA) PLC
Location: Phnom Penh
Employment Type: Full Time

• Prepare and update daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual operational and management reports.
• Develop, maintain, and enhance interactive Dashboards and Reporting solutions (Excel or BI base).
• Gather reporting requirements from business users and translate them into meaningful dashboards and reports.
• Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and modelling using Power Query, Power Pivot, and other analytical tools.
• Develop and maintain reusable data models and reporting datasets.
• Analyze insurance premiums, claims, policy performance, loss ratios, customer complaints, and operational KPIs.
• Monitor branch, sales, and business performance and provide analytical insights.
• Maintain data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reporting standards.
• Support data governance initiatives and improve data quality.
• Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.
• Support UAT for new systems, reports, and enhancement initiatives.
• Document reporting procedures, dashboard specifications, and data definitions.
• Collaborate with Operations, Claims, Finance, Sales, IT, and Management teams.
• Support digital transformation and business improvement initiatives.
• Perform ad-hoc analysis and other duties assigned by management.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in BI, data analytics, reporting, or related fields (experience in banks or MFIs is an advantage).
• Basic understanding of banking operations (Loan, Deposit, Digital Banking, Fraud/AML concepts).
• Strong interest in data analysis and BI development.
• Proficient in Power BI (visualization, data modeling basics).
• Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python.
• Experience with Power Query for data transformation.
• Basic understanding of Azure AD and Power BI service/embedded.
‌Monthly salary
Khmer New Year Bonus (equal to one-month of base salary)
Pchum Ben Bonus (equal to one-month of base salary)
Year-end bonus
